dishes.name: Afyon ekmek kadayıfı
dishes.desc: Soft bread dessert soaked in syrup and served under a thick spoon of Afyon kaymak. It is geographically registered and counted among the city's best-known sweets.

dishes.name: Afyon sucuk
dishes.desc: Spiced beef sausage with a geographical indication, eaten at breakfast, with eggs or in pide. Afyon is one of Türkiye's best-known sucuk towns.

dishes.name: Poppy seed bükme
dishes.desc: Layered pastry rolled with poppy seeds, traditionally with a lentil filling, crisp outside and filling inside. Poppy seeds are what set it apart from ordinary börek in Afyon.

dishes.name: İlibada dolması
dishes.desc: Leaves of the local ilibada herb wrapped around a filling and cooked slowly in a pot. A regional herb dish found on Afyon family tables.

dishes.name: Şuhut keşkek
dishes.desc: Göce wheat, chickpeas and meat cooked for hours in an earthen pot, sometimes served with kaymak and a sauce. Named after Şuhut, a district of Afyon.
